summary:
Does your MagSafe connector no longer snap on? Or does your USB-C port only charge if you hold the cable at exactly the right angle?

We repair MacBook Air charging ports at board level, so the fix actually lasts. Small component repairs start from R900. MagSafe 2 port repairs on older models cost R900 to R1,800, and USB-C controller or MagSafe 3 repairs on newer models cost R1,200 to R2,500, depending on the fault. In most cases we restore the port without swapping the whole board.

Every job starts with a free diagnostic and carries a 6-month warranty.

Tap Book to arrange your repair with us.
